utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mara, I’ve got word that Quinn’s spreading it around, and Opal will check the location and tell Eli. Sounds like the repair drive is coming together.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good, then I’m headed to Maple and 3rd with the extra hands so we can keep the bigger fixes moving and get the cleanup done.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll tell folks the bigger fixes are heading your way and keep the cleanup moving.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Rosa's handling the list and I'll keep Opal posted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help with the repair drive too, and I heard Ira’s bringing whatever we still need after errands.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I can swing by after my errands and bring whatever we need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, but is the schedule and parts list confirmed yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet, but I know Jules and Oren are on it, and I’ll check the parts list while I’m out so we can lock it down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Leo, Sam’s happy to help, and Tess said they still need a few more hands this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great, let’s get them out there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll let them know they’re needed this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, I’m happy to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m glad to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m on it too. I’ll confirm the timing and parts list with Mara, then bring the updated handoff notes.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with the repair drive too. I’ll keep an eye on the timing and parts list once you’ve got Mara’s update.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I will, and I’ll check with Mara first so the handoff stays current.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can check the repair drive list and fill in whatever’s still missing. Vik can help too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll wait for Opal to check the location and let me know before I make any plans.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good. I’ll keep checking the list and fill in anything that’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’ll bring the drill and a few screwdrivers by after lunch so we can get the drive squared away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, and if Quinn still needs people, I can spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, I’ll keep an ear out for Quinn and we’ll get it squared away after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Right, it’s still at the corner by Maple and 3rd, and it has gloves, zip ties, tape, and basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — Quinn should tell everyone to come by, and I think Vik can help too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, but let’s wait for Rosa’s list before adding anyone else.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supply list ready. Once Quinn points Rey to the part that still needs work, we can get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll point Rey to it, and we can have Vik greeting people so the drive keeps moving.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then we’re set on the supply side once Rey is pointed to the spot that still needs work.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It’s after lunch now, so the drive should be a little easier to sort out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, that gives us some breathing room. Gus can bring his parts, and with the tools kept tidy we should be able to get it squared away.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the drive once I’ve had a little time on my end.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s fine, Uli. We’ve got the repair drive set for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep the list organized and send Bo the details.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll check my side and let you know when I can make it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just want to make sure there’s enough room and the tools stay organized for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s at the corner by Maple and 3rd, and I’ll keep the bigger fixes and cleanup moving once the tools are lined up.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps. I just want to be sure there’s enough room at the corner and the tools stay in order for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: After lunch works for me. Gus and Sam can help, and if Pia has room, we should keep the tools organized.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with the repair drive after lunch, and I’ll keep the tools organized with you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, then we’re set for after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, that’s right — the drive is at the corner by Maple and 3rd, with gloves, zip ties, tape, and basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, I can help with that too, and I’ll let Ira know what’s still needed for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That covers it — I’ll keep an eye on it until Rosa’s list comes through.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds like Mara and Ben are handling the organizing, and Quinn’s getting the word out. Opal said she’d check the location and let Eli know too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, and Mara’s still keeping the list together, so it sounds like they’ve got most of it covered.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you bring the drill and a few screwdrivers by this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I’ll bring the drill and a few screwdrivers by after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll let Cleo know if you bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The repair drive is set for Sunday at the community center, and I’m getting the list organized now so I can send Bo the details.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll check the repair drive location and let Eli know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the schedule locked in, and I’ll make sure Bo gets the organized list. If you see Nell, point her to the table for me.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with that after I’ve had a little time on my end.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, and Quinn said everyone should come by for the repair drive. Ira can bring what we need after errands, and Vik can help too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I can do that once I’ve had a little time on my end.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Mara’s keeping the list, Ben from block watch is helping her organize it, and I can ask Vik to pitch in too. We still need a couple people to greet arrivals and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll ask around for two folks to greet people at the door and keep the line moving.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m on it too, Sam. I’ll check with Mara on the timing and parts list, then bring you the updated handoff notes.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks, Oren. I appreciate you handling that and I’ll be ready when the updated notes come in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’ll check with Mara and bring you the updated notes as soon as I have the timing and parts list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got the supply list going. Point Rey to the part that still needs work, and we can keep the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Tess said there are still a few more hands needed this afternoon, so I’ll point Rey their way.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good, then I’ll keep the list updated while Rey gets pointed to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the schedule and parts list still aren't confirmed, right?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, they’re still not confirmed yet, are they?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved again from Sunday at the community center to Monday at the school gym.
